newsitem.title: USA: Landslide derails freight train in Wash. state.
newsitem.headline: Landslide derails freight train in Wash. state.

text.p: A Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp. freight train was derailed by a landslide in the Cascade Mountains, but no cargo was spilled and there were no injuries, railroad officials said Monday.

Railroad spokesman Gus Melonas said three locomotives and one container car were knocked off the tracks when rocks, trees and other debris crashed down onto them early Sunday near Stevens Pass, about 50 miles northeast of Seattle.
Freight trains were being detoured, but crews expected to reopen the affected line Tuesday morning, Melonas said.
